In Europe, RevPAR grew 4.3% year-over-year, led by the U.K. and Ireland and continent-wide strong business and leisure performance.
In the Middle East and Africa region, RevPAR decreased approximately 30% year-over-year, which was better than prior expectations.
In the Asia Pacific region, second quarter RevPAR was up 6.3% in APAC ex China, led by strength in business and leisure and overall strength in Japan and Korea.
RevPAR in China decreased 2.2% in the quarter, driven by a decline in group travel resulting from continued government restrictions.
Turning to development, as Chris mentioned, for the quarter, we grew net units 6.1% and now have more than 541,000 rooms in our pipeline.
